name: EDLR 3090
title: Directed Observation and Participation in Sport Organizations
description: Prior to registration, students must apply for Directed Observation, complete a learning agreement, and provide for their own transportation. Mentors include educators and sport professionals. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: Open only to students in EDLR programs or select students in the Individualized Majors program. Not open to students who have passed KINS 3090.
